- You speak Dutch or English
- You have your own transport to get to the work location
- You are available in the afternoon and in the morning

What will you do
As a warehouse employee you will work in the sorting process of DPD Tynaarlo. You are responsible for loading and unloading trucks. You will also manually sort and scan packages. Please note, this can sometimes be a bit harder work! Fortunately, you don't have to do this for long, because the shifts are shorter than 8 hours per day. You can work in the following shifts:

- Night shift: Monday from 6:45 am to 10:00 am
- Morning shift: Tuesday to Saturday from 4:00 AM to 07:30 AM
- Afternoon shift: Monday to Friday from 4:00 PM to 8:00 PM

Where will you work
At DPD Tynaarlo you will end up in a company where collaboration is paramount. They have a good working atmosphere in the warehouse. Every day, many warehouse employees are busy sorting packages and loading/unloading the trucks. The delivery drivers are also supported with loading the vans. #baanrader
